issue_context.title: Problems rendering multiline items in Tree.
issue_context.body:
### Godot version

4.1.dev

### System information

Ubuntu 22.04.1 LTS

### Issue description

![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/85438892/234891938-c03c1172-9a55-493f-aa20-47d83cc449ef.png)

When I click one of the items it becomes normal, but the little line on the left doesn't match the icon:

![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/85438892/234892457-57af338a-16fe-4d82-8a41-c19ff8225e84.png)


### Steps to reproduce

Go to the Node tab in the editor.

### Minimal reproduction project

N/A

review_comments: Wrap mode probably should be exposed as item property (similar to `Label` and other controls).
I think this should be done as a separate PR, as `AutowrapMode` includes more than just `LineBreakFlag`.

For the start _LineBreakFlag_ would e.g. fix this here in editor. 
More then one line makes it IMO unreadable, for more info we have the tooltip.
